acceptance.given: A pre-standard fixture is supplied to strict-mode validation.

acceptance.then: Strict mode rejects the pre-standard fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute the strict-mode pre-standard-fixture test and observe acceptance or silent-valid treatment.
